props.title: Moscow–Kyiv talks
props.caption: Moscow and Kyiv. Final POW-exchange terms are agreed, while territorial differences remain outside the deal.
Nvidia named Colette Kress interim chief executive after Jensen Huang resigned.
The UN Council renewed Houthi sanctions and sought tighter controls on drone and missile components.

items.note: Kushner said Russia and Ukraine agreed final prisoner-exchange terms after talks in Moscow.
A Turkish court jailed nine people pending trial after the HABAŞ steel-plant explosion; production is suspended.

lead.what: Russia and Ukraine agreed final POW-exchange terms, while territorial differences remain outside the prisoner deal.
Nvidia named Colette Kress interim chief executive after Jensen Huang resigned.

rest.what: Mercedes-Benz halted further investment in German plants while reviewing site viability.

lead.what: The UN Security Council renewed targeted Houthi sanctions through 2027.

rest.what: A Turkish court jailed nine people pending trial over the HABAŞ steel-plant explosion.
